The business reached more than two million customers in 15 months and sold more than 6.5 million chocolate pieces, reaching more than 100 airports around the world. The 'Dubai Chocolate' hashtag also recorded 13.8 billion views in three months.

Sarah Hamouda and Yezen Alani transformed a home-based business in Dubai into a global success. Sales of Dubai-style chocolate surged by 1,234% in one year, and today, these products are sold in markets around the world and at more than 100 airports. This is the spirit of Dubai-it: transforming a simple home-based business into a global success. Congratulations to the FIX Dessert team.
